annotations.title: Send a quote to the customer

description: Sends one draft quote, named by id, to its customer on WhatsApp: its PDF and a summary with Accept, Ask a question and Not now. Accept turns it into an order (with a deposit link when the quote asks for one). Each call needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it sends the quote. Returns the quote.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The quote, by its qt_ id.
